about.title: About
about.descrption: It does not claim to replace the standard or be the final authority. Its purpose is to facilitate understanding of the standard.

selectLanguage.label: Select a language from the list of available languages. See also <0>Language tags and codes</0>.

theme.title: Theme settings
theme.btnLightTitle: Light theme mode (User theme mode source)
theme.btnDarkTitle: Dark theme mode (User theme mode source)
theme.sourceInfoLabel: A source manipulating the theme mode.
theme.modeInfoLabel: When the source is set to User, the theme mode is controlled by the user. When the source is set to System, the theme mode is taken from the device’s system setting. If it can’t be retrieved, Dark mode is used.
theme.schemeInfoLabel: For each theme mode, you can choose its own color scheme from the available list.
